caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall-mounted cabinet with multiple compartments and an ornate top panel. The cabinet is rectangular in shape and divided into nine sections of varying sizes by vertical and horizontal wooden dividers. The wood is brown with visible grain patterns, giving it a natural appearance. The top of the cabinet features an intricately carved decorative crest with a central circular motif surrounded by swirling foliate patterns. The overall color scheme consists of shades of brown for the wood, with shadows and highlights creating a sense of depth. The background is a plain, off-white color. Near the bottom right of the image, the name "Ithel Dougan" and the year "1937" are written in red-brown ink.
title: Hand Carved Cabinet
